subject: Purchase reference visibility & line item splits for AuroraStack onboarding
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Soto <karen@aurorastack.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase reference visibility & line item splits for AuroraStack onboarding

Hi Karen,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — great to get momentum on the AuroraStack integration. Two quick asks from our side to keep the onboarding/PO flow moving:

1) Can you confirm a provisional vendor PO number we can reference while finance issues the internal purchase reference? That helps us allocate spend caps immediately.

2) Aurora’s initial invoice layout looks like a single line for the platform subscription + a lump sum for onboarding/prof services. For our internal reporting we need the invoiced amounts split into: 
   - Consumption (monthly usage)
   - Professional services (one-time onboarding)

Attached is the Redwood onboarding form with the expected SKUs and suggested cost-center mapping. If you can populate the vendor setup form and return it, procurement can create the PR and map cost centers.

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_form.xlsx (filled template)

Can we aim to have the provisional PO and filled vendor form by EOD Tuesday (6/16)? That would keep us on the target onboarding timeline.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_onboarding_form.xlsx (spreadsheet; 37KB)

From: Karen Soto <karen@aurorastack.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: purchasing@aurorastack.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase reference visibility & line item splits for AuroraStack onboarding

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the note and the template. We can provide a provisional PO: AS-PO-2026-0783. I’ve attached our supplier setup form with bank/contracting info.

Regarding the invoice layout: we can split into two line items as you requested:
- AS-CON (Platform consumption) — monthly recurring
- AS-PS (Professional services) — one-time onboarding

Question: do you need the professional services to be invoiced as a single upfront amount or split across the first two months? Some customers prefer amortization; we can do either.

I’m attaching the completed vendor form and a soft copy of the SOW for your records.

Attachments: AuroraStack_supplier_setup_form.pdf (PDF; 48KB)

Let me know the preference and we’ll proceed to signature.

Cheers,
Karen Soto
Vendor Ops Manager
AuroraStack
Attachment: AuroraStack_supplier_setup_form.pdf (PDF; 48KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Soto <karen@aurorastack.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase reference visibility & line item splits for AuroraStack onboarding

Karen —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the provisional PO number (AS-PO-2026-0783). For Redwood accounting we prefer the professional services to be a one-time invoice (AS-PS) so it’s easier to tag to the onboarding project code. Consumption stays monthly.

Two small clarifications on the vendor form:
- Bank ACH: please confirm the beneficiary name exactly as it appears on the bank record (we had a mismatch with another vendor last quarter).
- Tax ID: please confirm whether AuroraStack will invoice including sales tax or if it’s tax-exempt for Redwood (we’ll need exemption docs if applicable).

I’ve attached a quick CSV that maps the two line items to proposed internal GL cost centers — happy to update after finance confirms.

Attachments: lineitem_breakdown_v1.csv

If you can confirm ACH beneficiary + tax posture by EOD Thursday (6/18) we’ll push PR creation into finance that day.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: lineitem_breakdown_v1.csv (CSV; 3KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karen Soto <karen@aurorastack.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase reference visibility & line item splits for AuroraStack onboarding

Folks —

I created the internal purchase reference: PR-RED-2026-3344 and mapped the two AuroraStack lines to the following cost centers:
- PR-RED-2026-3344-01 -> Consumption (Cloud Ops / GL 4201)
- PR-RED-2026-3344-02 -> Professional Services (Onboarding / GL 5302)

I uploaded the mapping sheet to the PR and attached the workbook for your records. Please confirm that AS-PO-2026-0783 is the correct vendor PO to tie to PR-RED-2026-3344. Once confirmed we will send the DocuSign package for signature.

DocuSign link (live): https://docusign.com/s/5a3f9b-AuroraStack-Redwood-SOW

Attachments: PR_mapping_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet; 12KB)

Laura Bennett
Manager, Revenue Operations & Finance
Redwood Inference
Attachment: PR_mapping_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet; 12KB)

From: Karen Soto <karen@aurorastack.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 14:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase reference visibility & line item splits for AuroraStack onboarding

Hi Laura / team —

Confirmed: vendor PO AS-PO-2026-0783 should be tied to PR-RED-2026-3344. ACH beneficiary name is "AuroraStack, Inc." and our tax posture for Redwood is: standard taxable (we will include sales tax where applicable). I’ve countersigned the SOW and uploaded the signed copy to the DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: AuroraStack_signed_SOW.pdf (signed SOW; 94KB)

Next steps from our side:
- We will send the first invoice against AS-CON for the agreed start date (service activation).
- Professional services invoice (AS-PS) will be issued as a single line within 14 days of the activation date.

Thanks all — ready to kick off once the PR is fully in finance.

Warmly,
Karen Soto
Vendor Ops Manager
AuroraStack
Attachment: AuroraStack_signed_SOW.pdf (signed PDF; 94KB)
